# Introduction {.unnumbered}
These BKRCast validation Quarto pages are used as references for calibrating and validating the BKRCast model. 

#### Tips for Navigating Pages {.unnumbered}
- You can access **Basic Summary** by clicking the **forward arrow** at the bottom of the page. 
- You may navigate to any desired analysis page by selecting the item from the left sidebar.
